product_launches.description: View launched a cloud-native smart building platform for managing building portfolios with enhanced cybersecurity features.

overview_description.description: View is the leader in smart building technologies that transform buildings to improve human health and experience, reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions, and generate additional revenue for building owners. View Smart Windows use artificial intelligence to automatically adjust in response to the sun, increasing access to natural light and unobstructed views while eliminating the need for blinds and minimizing heat and glare. Every View installation includes a cloud-connected smart building platform that can be extended to reimagine the occupant experience. View is installed and designed into over 90 million square feet of buildings, including offices, hospitals, airports, educational facilities, hotels, and multifamily residences.

product.name: View Smart Windows
product.description: Electrochromic smart windows that automatically or manually adjust tint to control sunlight, heat, glare and UV exposure while preserving daylight and exterior views.

product.name: View Intelligence
product.description: A predictive smart-building platform that uses building and environmental data to adjust window tint and support occupant comfort, facilities operations and space utilization.

product.name: View Building Analysis Services
product.description: Building-performance analysis for evaluating how smart windows affect glare, thermal comfort, daylight, energy use, HVAC sizing, life-cycle costs and LEED objectives.
